notes: Machine-readable list of agent-ready tasks for Commonweave. Pick one. See AGENTS.md for workflow.

tasks.title: Verify one underrepresented country
tasks.goal: Pick one country with fewer than 50 organizations in the directory (most of the 172 countries qualify) and verify or improve at least 10 records.
acceptance_criteria: At least 10 organizations checked
Broken links corrected or marked
Misclassified records corrected
No vulnerable group exposed unnecessarily
PR includes a short methodology note (what was checked, how, with what sources)

tasks.title: Add high-confidence-only map toggle
tasks.goal: Add a map toggle that filters to Tier B organizations with alignment_score >= 5 (~10,824 of ~27,217 geocoded points currently shown).
acceptance_criteria: Toggle is visible on desktop and mobile
Default map behavior remains unchanged
Filtered mode explains what high-confidence means in 1-2 sentences
Map still loads without console errors

tasks.title: Add provenance metadata to map edges
tasks.goal: Update generated edges in data/build_map_v2.py to include edge_type, confidence, explanation, created_at, and source_script.
acceptance_criteria: Edge schema includes edge_type, confidence, explanation, created_at, source_script
Map can display or inspect edge explanation (hover, click, or panel)
Build script documents how confidence is assigned
Existing map data remains backward compatible (no broken renders)

tasks.title: Backfill legibility for one country
tasks.goal: Classify records in one country as formal, hybrid, informal, or unknown. The legibility column was added 2026-04-22; as of 2026-04-25, ~25,980 records still read 'unknown' and ~138,803 read 'formal' (auto-classified at ingest time). Either subset is worth working in -- pick a country and audit/backfill there.
acceptance_criteria: At least 20 records reviewed
Each classification has an evidence note in the PR or remains unknown
Informal/vulnerable groups handled conservatively (default to unknown if any doubt)
PR explains classification method

tasks.title: Add one serious falsifier
tasks.goal: Pick one claim in README.md or DEEP-DIVE.md and define what evidence would weaken or falsify it.
acceptance_criteria: Claim is quoted or referenced precisely (file + section)
Falsifier is concrete and observable
At least one source or real-world case is cited
PR explains whether the claim should be kept, weakened, or marked unresolved

tasks.title: Fill one [NEEDS EXAMPLE] cell
tasks.goal: The governance matrix in README.md has cells marked [NEEDS EXAMPLE]. Pick one. Find a real organization (preferably already in the directory) that fits. Cite source.
acceptance_criteria: One cell filled with a named organization
Source cited (URL, registry, news, or peer-reviewed)
1-2 sentence explanation of why it fits
If org isn't in the directory, link to where it should be added

tasks.title: Seed CLAIMS.md with 10 claims from README
tasks.goal: Extract at least 10 specific claims from README.md and add them to CLAIMS.md with status, confidence, evidence (or lack of), and falsifier ideas.
acceptance_criteria: At least 10 claims extracted, each tied to a README section
Each has status (draft/supported/disputed/unresolved)
Each has confidence (low/medium/high)
Do not overstate certainty
At least 3 claims include concrete falsifiers

tasks.title: Document at least 3 attack vectors
tasks.goal: Add at least 3 attack vectors to ATTACK-VECTORS.md (e.g. corporate capture, state surveillance, data extraction, founder bottleneck, spam flooding, ideological hardening).
acceptance_criteria: Each vector has: threat, who benefits, who is harmed, early warning signs, countermeasures, open questions
Vectors are realistic, not paranoid
Cross-references THREAT-MODEL.md where relevant

tasks.title: Improve mobile map controls
tasks.goal: Make map.html usable on a phone. Touch-friendly filter panel, better popups, no horizontal overflow.
acceptance_criteria: Filter panel is reachable and operable on a 375px-wide screen
Popups don't overflow viewport
No horizontal scroll on the page
Existing desktop behavior unchanged

tasks.title: Create llms.txt and llms-full.txt at repo root
tasks.goal: Add a curated llms.txt index pointing to README, CRITIQUE, AGENTS, AGENT-TASKS, data contributing guide, map, directory. Add a longer llms-full.txt digest.
acceptance_criteria: llms.txt is a short curated index following the llmstxt.org spec
llms-full.txt contains a longer machine-readable digest
Both link to canonical site URLs (commonweave.earth or simonlpaige.com/commonweave/) where applicable
Both are kept short enough to be useful (no whole-file dumps)

tasks.title: Audit the first four circuit briefs before outreach
tasks.goal: Audit the Hartford, Syracuse, Tulsa, and Durham circuit briefs against current public sources before any brief is delivered through a local channel.
acceptance_criteria: All listed organizations still have a current public presence
Each proposed role is supported by a cited public source or the brief is corrected
No listed organization is made more visible than its own public communications support
The review records whether the brief should be delivered, revised, or withdrawn
No outreach is sent as part of the audit

tasks.title: Preserve reviewed amendments across a new canonical export
tasks.goal: Reconcile releases/AMENDMENTS.json into a separately staged canonical export without losing source identities or earlier accepted field corrections.
acceptance_criteria: Inputs remain read-only and ambiguous identity or changed expected values fail before output
Sequential amendment history and field evidence survive without overwriting earlier decisions
Affected download formats and directory representations agree, while unrelated snapshots are preserved
Conflict and replay tests pass; public verification dates are not invented

tasks.title: Unstack the 11,399 UK pins that share one coordinate
tasks.goal: In data/map/orgs.geojson, 11,399 GB points sit on the country centroid (-3.44, 55.38), so the map's largest cluster is one dot in rural Scotland. Geocode these rows to their registered postcode district or town from the Charity Commission extract, record the precision used, and leave rows with no usable locality off the map instead of on the centroid.
acceptance_criteria: No more than 50 map points share any single coordinate unless that coordinate is a documented city centroid
Each moved point records a precision value (postcode_district, city, or country)
Rows that cannot be placed are counted and reported, not pinned to a centroid
Requires the canonical database; state which snapshot was used

tasks.title: Repair the 9,843 map rows whose tier field holds an activity code
tasks.goal: 9,843 of 29,423 features in data/map/orgs.geojson have a value other than A/B/C/D in the `t` property (mostly NTEE-style codes), so the default filters hide them. Fix the export mapping in the map build so `t` comes from the canonical tier column.
acceptance_criteria: Every exported feature has t in A/B/C/D
Tier is read from the canonical column and never inferred from an activity code
Before/after counts of visible points are reported

tasks.title: Run the Murmurations ingest against the canonical database and dedupe
tasks.goal: data/ingest_murmurations.py dry-ran on 2026-11-26 at 6,853 usable rows (6,704 with coordinates, 6,848 with a website, 133 countries). 477 share a normalized name and country with a row in the April release. Run it against the canonical database, then resolve those overlaps with data/dedup_merge.py before any export.
acceptance_criteria: Ingest is run with COMMONWEAVE_DB set explicitly and the row counts are recorded
Name+country overlaps are reviewed; merged rows keep both source identities
1,012 rows without a country code are either resolved from coordinates or left blank, not guessed
DATA.md source table is updated with the real inserted count

tasks.title: Re-check the sources behind one solution circuit by hand
tasks.goal: Every precedent and limit in data/circuits.yaml was opened by an automated pass on 2026-11-26. Pick one circuit, open each source yourself, and confirm the page says what the `finding` states.
acceptance_criteria: Every source for the chosen circuit opened and compared with its finding
Wrong or drifted findings corrected, or the precedent removed
`checked` date updated only for sources you opened
`python data/build_circuits.py --check` passes after rebuilding
PR lists each source and what you saw

tasks.title: Run a second, blind precision review of role rules
tasks.goal: Run FALSIFIERS.md F-DATA-4 for at least five roles. The first review (data/audit/circuit-role-precision.json) used names only and one reviewer.
acceptance_criteria: At least 30 matches per role judged from the organization's own public pages
Reviewer did not read the earlier scores first
Results added as a dated second review, not overwriting the first
Any rule under 60% is tightened or removed from circuits, with the reason in the PR
No sensitive group contacted or given more detail than its own pages show

tasks.title: Scope a source for union locals and central labor councils
tasks.goal: The labor-for-housing, worker-transition and care-work circuits need union locals, and the release has almost none in the United States (26 records modelled as unions; most labor-code rows are joint labor-management funds). Identify a public, reusable source and write an ingest brief. Do not ingest in the same PR.
acceptance_criteria: Source named with its licence or reuse terms
Sample of 20 rows shown with fields mapped to the directory schema
Safety note: organizing campaigns and worker centres are not to be listed from non-public sources
Estimate of how many circuit cities this would add, from `data/build_circuits.py` on a staged sample

tasks.title: Remove non-unions from the Wikidata union source
tasks.goal: The `wikidata_unions` source labels some non-unions as labor unions. Three found on 2026-11-26: release ids 763497 (Aleph, JP), 763843 (Royal Society of Chemistry, GB) and 763493 (Guerriers de lumières, FR). Audit the 405 rows and propose corrections through data/stage_organizations.py.
acceptance_criteria: All 405 rows reviewed against their Wikidata item
Proposal file validates without writing data
Each proposed change cites the Wikidata item or the organization's own site
No row deleted; misclassified rows are reclassified or flagged

tasks.title: Find a checked precedent for an untested circuit, or remove it
tasks.goal: Two circuits (food waste-to-soil loop, civic information commons) have no source-checked precedent. For one of them, find a documented case of the listed roles working together, with at least one documented limit, or delete the circuit.
acceptance_criteria: Precedent source opened and quoted accurately, or the circuit removed
At least one limit recorded
Evidence level changed to match
Generated files rebuilt and tests pass

tasks.title: Repair Brazilian city names that lost accented letters
tasks.goal: City names from the Brazil ingest dropped accented characters instead of transliterating them (the release has 'SO PAULO' for São Paulo and 'SO JOO DE MERITI'). This breaks locality matching and display. Find where the characters are lost and propose a repair from the original source values.
acceptance_criteria: Cause identified in the ingest or export path
Repair derives names from source data, not from guessing missing letters
Count of affected rows reported
No change applied to the release without the amendment process in docs/RELEASE-AMENDMENTS.md

tasks.title: Have a practitioner mark up one OPEN-PROBLEMS.md entry
tasks.goal: Each entry in OPEN-PROBLEMS.md was written from published sources by an outsider. Find one person who works in the field of one entry (re-entry, development economics, repressive-context organizing, Indigenous land governance) and record their corrections with consent.
acceptance_criteria: Reviewer consents to how they are credited or stays unnamed
Their disagreements are recorded even where the position is kept
No outreach is sent by an automated agent
